speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: It goes. I took the weight off. The weight was the piece you said was the engine, and the engine was the reason it hit the board.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I intended that. The weight was the first design. The second design is the weight gone. You have done what I was going to do after dinner.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You are allowed the intention. You are not allowed the sentence that she only happened to be there. She took it off. It works slightly better. That is the report.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the report is the report. I am not taking it to London in either version. A machine that works is still your machine.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It reaches the window. Not every time. Often enough that Judith is unbearable about it, which is the proof.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Often enough is three times out of four. I counted. The fourth caught on the latch, and the latch is a different play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three out of four, and the weight on the blanket where I can see it. Leave it there.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Show him the three, then. A report he has not seen is only another story, and he has promised us he is done with stories.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The first. Stairhead to the turn. No weight. Watch the bobbin, not me.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: One. That is the message. It is blank, which is still a message, because the last one never left the board.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The second. I am not helping it. If I help it, she will say the help was the method.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Two. It bumped the latch and went on. Slightly better is not perfect. Slightly better is what I said, and I am not improving it for you.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The third is hers to send. Hamnet, your hand stays off the spool.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: My hand is off. I intended the hand to be off. That is the method I have been intending since the knot.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Three. Window. The paper is still blank, and the blank is still better than a weight against a board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three out of four was your count, Judith. I have seen three arrivals. I have not seen the fourth, and I do not need it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The fourth was the latch, and the latch is not my design. A latch is a house. A house may interrupt a method without cancelling it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He may keep the intention. She keeps the deed. Father keeps the promise. That is three owners, and none of them is London.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: London is not getting it. Not the failure, and not the three arrivals. I said so this morning, and the morning has not changed its mind.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then the weight stays on the blanket, where a man on the floor can see the piece he thought was essential.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I think it was essential until it was not. Both of those can be true if a person is allowed to learn, which I am, because I am ten and not a post.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You are ten, and you are also not to make a speech about being ten. Come and eat. If we stay he will design a third, and the third will want the weight back.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The weight is not coming back. I have put it where his hand can find it and his string cannot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. Go and eat. I like a piece that was essential until it wasn't, and I am not writing it down.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Three out of four, and the weight stays where I put it. Eat.
